summary: A real gfx1151 Q4_K_M 512/1 smoke proves that model-layer host drains execute, preserve the exact result, and carry a measurable short-context cost. This does not establish 128K lifecycle safety.

kernel_lead.upstream_intent: Enable the MES lr_compute_wa resource bit to prevent hangs on long compute jobs.
kernel_lead.captured_source_observation: mes_v11_0_set_hw_resources sets oversubscription_timer=50 but does not set enable_lr_compute_wa.
kernel_lead.interpretation: The exact captured kernel omits a known long-compute workaround that MES 0x88 is new enough to accept. This is the leading fixed-stack A/B candidate, not root-cause proof.

platform.system: Framework Desktop / AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 395

command_template: HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=1 uv run python scripts/qwen35_readme_sweep.py --engine gguf --model /models/gguf/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-UD-Q4_K_M.gguf --quant gguf_q4_k_m --backend hip_gfx1151 --workloads 512/1 --warmup-runs 0 --measured-runs 1 --warmup-decode-tokens 1 --force-bulk-prefill --bulk-prefill-attention-mode bulk --use-wmma-prefill --use-gemv-decode --no-graph-replay-decode --prefill-queue-drain {none|layer} --require-cached-build --json /tmp/hipengine-q4km-{mode}-512.json

correctness_gate.evidence: Final token and final logit are exactly equal; both results report finite logits.
correctness_gate.limitation: A 512/1 smoke is not the repository's 128K lifecycle closure gate.

validation.red: The new tests initially failed because the queue-drain resolver and runtime path did not exist. A later real smoke also exposed stale readme-sweep helper forwarding for roctx and rocprof_selected_region.
validation.focused_tests: 38 passed across the queue-drain, bulk-prefill, flight-recorder, and helper-signature nodes before the hardware pair.
validation.hardware: Both matched 512/1 processes exited 0 on gfx1151.

next_gate: Run exact 512/4K/64K controls, then at least three independent 128K warmup+3 processes with --prefill-queue-drain layer. This exceeds five minutes and requires explicit approval under the repository validation policy.
